acceptance_criteria.description: Selected host proves required launcher FUSE fakeroot cgroup and GPU prerequisites for the fixture without recording private host details
One digest-bound no-agent SIF or sandbox smoke covers timeout cancellation teardown network policy and durable artifact export
Stable job state survives disconnect and handoff records commit record root identities verification argv and one next action
The observation stays exploratory until standalone verifier closure and a benchmark execution capability are complete

objective: Exercise the pinned Apptainer runtime on an execution-only non-root host and retain independently verifiable fixture evidence without starting a paid or long benchmark.
title: Activate and verify Apptainer on a real non-root host
